PluginData.FriendlyName: Kontrol Joystick / HOTAS / HOSAS for Space Engineers
PluginData.Author: Komandio Labs
PluginData.Tooltip: Joystick, HOTAS, HOSAS, controller, and button-box controls for Space Engineers.
PluginData.Description:
Fly Space Engineers with your joystick, HOTAS, HOSAS, controller, or button box. This Pulsar Legacy plugin receives Kontrol mappings for pitch, roll, yaw, forward/reverse thrust, strafe, lift, Use tool / Fire weapon, Secondary mode, Inertia dampeners on / off, Lights on / off, Park, Handbrake, Broadcasting, local and connected-grid power, First-person / Third-person, camera look-around, third-person zoom, HUD, Terminal / Inventory, Inventory, Chat screen, Voice Chat, and toolbar slots 1-0 at the game's final ship-control update.
Learn more about and download Kontrol: https://www.komandio.com/kontrol
